_why: permission: 'read' MCP tools known to change persisted state (see test/integration/mcp-read-tools-do-not-mutate.test.js). This list only shrinks: fix a tool, then remove it here. kind 'write' changes rows of the tables in its 'tables' list, and the test fails if it changes anything else or stops writing a listed table; kind 'init' only creates empty structure (a table or index, a database with no rows, a directory) on first use, and the test fails if an 'init' tool ever changes more than that.

violations.reason: getCreditBalance -> x402_credits().get_balance -> get_or_create_account inserts an x402_credit_accounts row for every payer/asset/network queried.
Every hit increments payment_links.views and bumps updated_at (src/checkout/express.js resolvePaymentLink).
Creates <cwd>/.stateset/treasury/treasury.db (schema, no rows) on first use -- under the process working directory, not beside the server's --db.
First audit tool to run opens the scoped audit store, creating <db>.audit.db (schema, no rows).
First circuit-breaker tool to run creates the empty a2a_circuit_breaker_events and a2a_spending_ledger tables and their indexes.
First agent-catalog tool to run creates the empty agent_catalog table and its indexes.
Creates the empty <db dir>/.stateset/a2a-checkpoints directory on first use.
